narrative.overview: The app adapts TasteTrail India from Google AI Studio. The latest user-supplied palette image sets LightBlue #c3e7f1, Moonstone #519cab, Saffron #ffc64f and Gunmetal #20373b across app and waitlist. Light pages and pale cards use Gunmetal copy; primary/selected controls use Saffron with Gunmetal. App navigation, photo overlays and public how/FAQ/footer/signup form use Gunmetal with light text. Both illustrative maps use LightBlue and Moonstone while retaining their geometry and interactions. Palateo identity, Plus Jakarta Sans app typography and Asap Condensed/DM Sans public typography remain. Surface modes and acceptance live in docs/ZEST_REDESIGN_BRIEF.md.
keyCharacteristics: LightBlue pages, pale cards, Gunmetal copy and Saffron actions.
Moonstone detail and derived darker copy for readable small text.
TasteTrail app layout with preserved public typography and behavior.
Coordinated illustrative maps and live reversible feedback with honest persistence status.

rules.name: The Visible State Rule
rules.body: Selection and errors use text, pressed state or another visible cue as well as color.

rules.name: The Tonal Layer Rule
rules.body: App hierarchy comes from surface color and borders.

dos: Do use the four user-supplied colors across both surfaces, with derived neutrals for readable controls.
Do keep real venue estimates, explanations and actions together.
Do preserve the eight-question flow, authentication, consent, saves and reversible feedback.
Do retain native labels, pressed states, visible focus and reduced motion.
Do identify dish examples and map geometry as illustrative and keep cloud status honest.
donts: Do not restore superseded palettes or use light text on light controls.
Do not describe flavour examples as verified venue menu items.
Do not claim measured prediction accuracy, live hours or navigation from schematic paths.
Do not add bank linking, dependencies, a database migration or deployment to reproduce the reference.
